s.note: the little worm invites Sarah in to meet the missus
s.how: Toast 8 thick slices of fruit loaf until the edges crisp, butter generously and cut into fingers. Warm a teapot, add 4 tea bags and 1L boiling water and brew 4 minutes. Serve with milk on the side, like a guest in a burrow.

s.n: Bog of Eternal Stench garlic dip
s.note: the bog, but this one smells good
s.how: Wrap 2 whole garlic heads in foil and roast at 180C for 45 minutes. Squeeze out the soft cloves and beat with 250g cream cheese, 100g sour cream, lemon juice and salt until smooth. Serve with torn baguette for dipping.

m.note: Hoggle the dwarf and his little garden
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 250g mushrooms, add 250ml red wine and 500ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk and serve alongside.

w.note: the peach that sends Sarah to the masked ball
w.how: Simmer 375ml white wine, 150g sugar and a split vanilla bean for 5 minutes. Add 4 halved peaches and poach 10 minutes, then slip off the skins and chill in the syrup. Serve with 250g mascarpone and crumbled almond biscuits.

d.how: Pour 1L cloudy apple juice and 500ml pear juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks and 3 star anise. Simmer gently for 10 minutes so the spices come through. Serve warm in mugs, or cool it and pour over ice.
